results.description: Papa John's investors are alleged to have absorbed a $5.11 per-share single-session loss and a suspended dividend on August 6, 2026, in a securities action alleging the Company's strategic transformation was portrayed as working while it was allegedly taking longer than expected.

results.description: DAMASCUS, Oct. 13 (Xinhua) -- Syrian officials and World Bank Group President Ajay Banga on Tuesday discussed expanding financial support and accelerating development projects to support the country's economic recovery, state news agency SANA reported.
